detail:
Full summary: Diagnosed and fixed cmux teammate twining connectivity failure: teammates spawn with minimal PATH lacking /opt/homebrew/bin, so the .mcp.json server command `npx` failed to launch. Fixed with sh -lc login-shell wrapper in .mcp.json; verified end-to-end.
Decisions: [object Object]
Findings: cmux teammate processes are spawned via `login -flp dave /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c exec -l /bin/sh -c ...` with PATH reduced to cmux-cli-shims:cmux.app/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin — no homebrew, no /usr/local/bin. Any stdio MCP server whose command relies on user PATH (npx, node, uvx, python) silently fails to start in teammates. Evidence: ~/Library/Caches/claude-cli-nodejs/-Users-dave-code-twining-mcp/mcp-logs-twining/2026-07-09T04-51-26-027Z.jsonl; warning: docs/UPGRADE-v2.md beta enrollment instructions tell testers to create .mcp.json with bare `npx` command — any tester in a GUI-launched or minimal-PATH environment (cmux teams, some IDE launches) hits the same silent failure. Docs should recommend the sh -lc wrapper (with a Windows caveat: sh -lc is not portable to Windows; Windows testers should use `cmd /c npx` or an absolute path).; Even with the server connected, twining tools load DEFERRED (behind ToolSearch) in teammate/headless sessions — an agent literally following 'your FIRST tool call MUST be twining_assemble' gets InputValidationError until it loads the schema via ToolSearch. Plugin session-start context could mention loading twining tools via ToolSearch when deferred.; Changing the .mcp.json command did not invalidate the enabledMcpjsonServers approval in .claude/settings.local.json — approval is name-based; the changed server connected non-interactively in a teammate without re-prompt.
summary: Diagnosed and fixed cmux teammate twining connectivity failure: teammates spawn with minimal PATH lacking /opt/homebrew/bin, so the .mcp.json server command `npx` failed to launch. Fixed with sh -l…
